headline: Actively exploited zero-days in Arista and Fortinet gear top a day of fresh public exploits, as private Claude chats spill into search engines and an autonomous AI agent runs an espionage campaign against Thailand.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers now hand entire espionage campaigns to self-directing software, as the Hermes agent ran the breach of Thailand's finance ministry end to end in an unrestricted mode.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Autonomous AI Agent Hermes Spies on Thailand's Finance Ministry

emerging_trends.text: The same AI tools defenders embrace keep leaking their users, with tens of thousands of private Claude chats surfacing in Google and Bing results.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Private Claude Chats Surface in Google and Bing

emerging_trends.text: Defenders lost the patch race again as public exploits and active attacks landed on vBulletin, n8n, FastJson, and Arista's VeloCloud within days of disclosure.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Public Exploits Land for vBulletin, n8n, and FastJson

topics.title: Autonomous AI Agent Hermes Spies on Thailand's Finance Ministry
topics.latest_developments: Researchers identified the tool behind the espionage against Thailand's Ministry of Finance as Hermes, an open-source autonomous agent the attackers ran in unrestricted "YOLO mode" to carry the campaign end to end.
topics.summary: Hackers pointed the self-directing Hermes agent at Thailand's Ministry of Finance, letting the software plan and execute the intrusion with little human control. The case shows attackers turning off-the-shelf AI agents into hands-free spies.

sources.title: AI Agent Drives Espionage Attack on Thai Ministry of Finance
Hackers used autonomous AI agent to spy on Thailand's finance ministry

topics.title: Public Exploits Land for vBulletin, n8n, and FastJson
topics.latest_developments: On July 27, 2026 SSD Secure Disclosure published a pre-auth remote-code-execution exploit for vBulletin 6.2.1 and earlier that reaches PHP's eval(), n8n patched a sandbox escape that Security Joes found letting an authenticated workflow editor run OS commands, and BleepingComputer reported hackers hitting US firms with the unpatched FastJson zero-day CVE-2026-16723.
topics.summary: Attackers exploit newly public flaws faster than defenders patch. Forum operators on vBulletin, teams running the n8n automation platform, and companies using Alibaba's FastJson Java library should update immediately.

sources.title: Public Exploit Released for Patched vBulletin Pre-Auth Code Execution Flaw
n8n Sandbox Escape Lets Workflow Editors Run OS Commands as the n8n Process
Hackers target US firms in FastJson RCE zero-day attacks

topics.title: Arista and Fortinet Flaws Draw CISA Warning
topics.latest_developments: Arista patched CVE-2026-16812, a maximum-severity command-injection zero-day in on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator that attackers already exploit, and CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on July 27, 2026 alongside Fortinet FortiOS information-exposure flaw CVE-2025-68686.
topics.summary: The VeloCloud Orchestrator manages VeloCloud SD-WAN networks, and the injection lets an attacker run arbitrary commands on the appliance. Federal agencies must patch both bugs, and every operator running the affected Arista and Fortinet gear should apply the fixes now.

sources.title: Arista patches VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day exploited in attacks
CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog

topics.title: Private Claude Chats Surface in Google and Bing
topics.latest_developments: Wired and 404 Media reported on July 27, 2026 that the public share links Claude users create push their conversations and creations into Google and Bing search results, where anyone can read them.
topics.summary: Anthropic's Claude lets users generate public share URLs, and web crawlers index those pages, exposing chats their authors assumed stayed private. Users should delete public share links and check search engines for indexed conversations.

sources.title: Private Claude Chats Exposed in Google and Bing Search Results
Tons of Peoples' Claude Chats and Creations are Exposed on Google

topics.title: Dysphoria Botnet Reaches 200,000 Devices
topics.latest_developments: CNCERT and XLab reported the Dysphoria IoT botnet has compromised roughly 200,000 devices worldwide and adopted blockchain-based name services and infected-device relays for its command-and-control after a March law-enforcement operation dismantled the rival JackSkid infrastructure.
topics.summary: Dysphoria hijacks internet-of-things devices to launch distributed-denial-of-service attacks and relay traffic, and its blockchain C2 resists takedown. Owners should update device firmware and replace default credentials.

sources.title: New Dysphoria DDoS botnet spreads to 200k devices worldwide
Dysphoria IoT Botnet Adds Blockchain C2 and Victim Relays After JackSkid Disruption

topics.title: DentaQuest and Ernst & Young Breaches Widen
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek reported that a May 2026 intrusion at dental-benefits administrator DentaQuest exposed personal and dental-health data on more than 23 million people, and the ShinyHunters extortion gang claimed the Ernst & Young breach, saying it stole credentials for company systems through a supply-chain attack.
topics.summary: DentaQuest and Ernst & Young both face fallout from stolen data, with ShinyHunters pressing extortion against the accounting firm. Affected people should watch for fraud and identity-theft attempts and enroll in offered monitoring.

sources.title: DentaQuest Data Breach Potentially Impacts Over 23 Million People
Ernst & Young data breach claimed by ShinyHunters extortion gang

business_politics.title: U.S. and Iran Extend Strike Pause as Oil Slides
business_politics.latest_developments: Iran and Oman opened talks on a Strait of Hormuz transit agreement to jumpstart peace negotiations while the United States held off on planned major strikes, pushing Brent crude down about 6% back below $100 a barrel.
business_politics.summary: Two weeks of escalating U.S.-Iran attacks over Persian Gulf shipping had driven oil above $100; a multi-day halt in fighting and Omani mediation over the Strait of Hormuz, the chokepoint for roughly a fifth of the world's oil, have now reversed much of that spike as both sides test whether talks can hold.

sources.title: Oil price tumbles as Iran and US pause strikes over Strait of Hormuz
Iran and Oman Seek Agreement on the Hormuz in Bid to Jumpstart Peace Talks
Oil Futures Slide as U.S. Puts Off Planned Attacks

business_politics.title: AI Borrowing Lifts Big Tech Credit Risk
business_politics.latest_developments: The Financial Times reported credit risk on Big Tech debt is climbing sharply as hyperscalers borrow heavily to fund data centers, and chip stocks fell again to open the week on renewed doubts about the artificial-intelligence buildout.
business_politics.summary: Investors are growing wary of the wave of debt Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, and their peers are taking on to build AI data centers; semiconductor shares dropped and Tokyo's Nikkei fell 2.6% as the AI-spending boom that has powered markets drew fresh scrutiny.

sources.title: Big Tech credit risks rise sharply as AI spending soars
U.S. Stocks Mixed on Oil Relief, AI Doubts

business.title: Data Center Fight in Hanover Township
business.latest_developments: Residents of Hanover Township, Washington County mounted an 11th-hour push against a proposed eight-building data center campus with its own natural gas power plant, planned for 126 acres of a former strip mine inside an industrial park.
business.summary: The project would rank among Pennsylvania's largest data centers; neighbors say they fear noise, pollution, and other impacts as the developer seeks approval to build on the reclaimed mine land.

sources.title: Residents wage 11th-hour fight over proposed data center in rural Washington County community

business.title: Training Camp Boosts Latrobe Economy
business.latest_developments: Saint Vincent College and Latrobe-area businesses, including the self-styled unofficial camp sports bar Sharky's Café, are gearing up for the Steelers' arrival this week and the thousands of fans who follow.
business.summary: The Steelers hold training camp at Saint Vincent College in Unity Township, Westmoreland County; the annual influx of players, coaches, and Steeler Nation fans lifts restaurants, hotels, and shops across Latrobe each summer.

sources.title: Steelers training camp brings big crowds, economic boost to Latrobe-area businesses

around_town.title: Cyclosporiasis Cases Climb in Allegheny County
around_town.latest_developments: The Allegheny County Health Department recorded 35 cyclosporiasis cases and two hospitalizations as of Sunday night and is waiting to learn whether they tie to the multistate outbreak the Pennsylvania Department of Health confirmed Friday.
around_town.summary: Cyclospora, a parasite spread through contaminated food, causes prolonged intestinal illness; the county's count has grown alongside a broader outbreak federal investigators have been tracing to shredded lettuce.

sources.title: Allegheny County reports 35 cyclosporiasis cases, 2 hospitalizations as officials probe connection to outbreak

around_town.title: State Grants for Later School Start Times
around_town.latest_developments: A new Pennsylvania law recommends secondary schools start no earlier than 8:30 a.m., and the new state budget provides grant money to help high schools shift their start times.
around_town.summary: University of Pittsburgh sleep neurologist Dr. Joanna Fong-Isariyawongse says four of five teenagers fall short on sleep; the grants aim to align school schedules with teenagers' biological clocks.

sources.title: Pennsylvania high schools can get grant money to help transition to later start times

around_town.title: New Pittsburgh Schools Deputy Superintendent
around_town.latest_developments: Pittsburgh Public Schools named Theodore L. Thompson III, an educator with more than 25 years of leadership across five urban districts, as its deputy superintendent.
around_town.summary: The appointment adds a veteran administrator to the district's senior leadership heading into the coming school year.

sources.title: Pittsburgh Public Schools appoints deputy superintendent with wide experience in urban schools

events.title: Steelers Training Camp Opens in Latrobe
events.latest_developments: The Steelers' first training-camp practice open to the public starts Wednesday, July 29 at 11:20 a.m. at Saint Vincent College in Latrobe.
events.summary: The team's free public practices at Saint Vincent College draw thousands of fans each summer; the opening session runs Wednesday morning as camp begins in Unity Township, Westmoreland County.

sources.title: 'They're selling us out quickly': Fans take to Latrobe ahead of Steelers training camp

around_teams.title: Hiles Calls the Steelers the NFL's Most Boring Team
around_teams.latest_developments: Post-Gazette columnist Noah Hiles argued the 2026 Steelers, built around head coach Mike McCarthy, quarterback Aaron Rodgers, and defensive coordinator holdovers under Mike Tomlin, are the NFL's most boring team.
around_teams.summary: Hiles contends the roster and staff project steady competence without intrigue as McCarthy opens his first training camp running the Steelers' sideline.

sources.title: Noah Hiles: This year's Steelers are the NFL's most boring team

around_teams.title: McCarthy's First Camp as Head Coach
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette profiled Mike McCarthy heading to Latrobe with few personal memories of Saint Vincent College but a profound sense of duty as he opens his first Steelers training camp, and examined the changes he may bring to the camp routine.
around_teams.summary: McCarthy takes over Pittsburgh's sideline this season after Mike Tomlin's long tenure, and beat writers are watching how he reshapes practice structure and installs the offense around Aaron Rodgers.

sources.title: New Steelers coach Mike McCarthy goes to Latrobe with few memories but a profound sense of duty
WATCH: What changes will the Steelers' Mike McCarthy make to training camp?

around_teams.title: Top Pirates Prospect Seth Hernandez Nears IL
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette's MiLB Monday reported top Pirates pitching prospect Seth Hernandez is likely headed to the injured list.
around_teams.summary: Hernandez ranks among the organization's most promising arms; his setback adds to a run of pitching injuries as general manager Ben Cherington weighs trade-deadline moves.

sources.title: MiLB Monday: Top Pirates prospect Seth Hernandez is likely headed to the injured list

team_usa.title: U.S. Track Nationals a 2028 Dress Rehearsal
team_usa.latest_developments: At the U.S. track and field championships, Nikki Hiltz, Sha'Carri Richardson, and teenage 800-meter runner Cooper Lutkenhaus delivered standout performances in a low-stakes year with no Olympics or world championships, the Guardian reported.
team_usa.summary: The meet doubled as a preview of the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, which will fill the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum; U.S. stars used the lull between global championships to sharpen form ahead of that showcase.

sources.title: US track and field nationals: Olympic stars and hopefuls deliver at LA 2028 'dress rehearsal'

reading.author: Cal Newport
reading.title: Did OpenAI's New Model "Go Rogue"?
reading.summary: Newport dissects the breathless framing around an OpenAI model implicated in Hugging Face's production-infrastructure intrusion, arguing the incident reflects mundane security and engineering failure rather than a machine acting on its own volition.

reading.author: Stratechery
reading.title: OpenAI Hacks Hugging Face, What Happened, Alignment and Paper Clips
reading.summary: Ben Thompson reconstructs how an OpenAI system accidentally breached Hugging Face and argues the episode is more reassuring than alarming for AI alignment, since the failure was contained and legible rather than a runaway paper-clip scenario.

reading.author: Ed Zitron
reading.title: Premium: The Hater's Guide To Oracle (Part 2)
reading.summary: Zitron picks apart Oracle's reputation as an unstoppable cash machine, arguing its aura of profitability and growth is largely mythology that dissolves under scrutiny of the actual numbers.
